macros.name: beginpgfgraphicnamed
macros.doc: This command indicates that everything up to the next call of \endpgfgraphicnamed is part of a graphic that should be placed in a file named ⟨file name prefix⟩.⟨suffix⟩, where the ⟨suffix⟩ depends on your backend driver.

macros.name: endpgfgraphicnamed
macros.doc: This command just marks the end of the graphic that should be externalized.

macros.name: tikz
macros.doc: This command places the ⟨path commands⟩ inside a {tikzpicture} environment.

macros.name: tikzappendtofigurename
macros.doc: Appends ⟨suffix⟩ to the actual value of figure name.

macros.name: tikzset
macros.doc: This command will process the ⟨options⟩ using the \pgfkeys command, documented in detail in Section 87, with the default path set to /tikz.

macros.name: tikzsetexternalprefix
macros.doc: Assigns a common prefix used by all file names.

macros.name: tikzsetfigurename
macros.doc: Changes the names of all following figures.

macros.name: tikzsetnextfilename
macros.doc: Sets the file name for the next TikZ picture or \tikz short command.
